_note: Dummy account data. The two street addresses came from an address generator, and the account name is a placeholder on purpose - nothing here belongs to a real person, which matters because this package is public.
_shape_note: The key set mirrors GET /api/v3/storefront/account/init-profile, captured from a live store. Only the VALUES are invented. Fields the API does not send were removed: the addresses used to carry zone_id, country_id, latitude, longitude and tax_rate, and nothing reads the last three. zone_id/country_id mattered more - a real store sends zone_code/country_code and AddressForm.vue derives the ids from them, so supplying the ids meant the form's own lookup was never exercised here.
_tax_note: Tax is NOT a property of the address on this API - it is a figure the checkout returns, and the kit's lives in checkout.json (totals.tax). Set it to 0 there to preview a checkout with no tax line; a theme has to render both.

customer._username_note: Really null on a live store. The account is identified by email; a theme reading `username` for a display name gets nothing, and that is worth seeing here rather than after upload.
customer._group_pricing_note: An empty array is what init-profile answers with, oddly - the login response says null for the same field. Both are falsy, and the theme only passes the value through to a shipping estimate, so neither breaks anything.
